nodes:
TASK RECEIVED
Analyze module X
and generate context

SCOPE PHASE:
Read task description
Check devpt reports
(pie_report_freshness)
Identify module boundary

ORIENT PHASE:
file_api / symbols_by_file
for relevant files
(batch when ≥2 files)

META PHASE:
get_symbols_meta on
candidate symbols
(cheap: signature + tokens)

FETCH PHASE:
get_symbol (batch 5-8)
only high-value symbols
Read non-kernel if needed

ANALYZE PHASE:
Identify bugs, violations,
error gaps, inconsistencies
Categorize by severity

PACKAGE PHASE:
Collect symbol_names (5-8)
Collect file_paths for APIs
Keep blast radius focused

Reindex atlas
full regeneration
if stale or missing

Estimate token budget:
mean_symbol_tokens ×
blast_radius × 1.5
(set max_tokens high)

GENERATE PHASE:
minimal_context_dump
with symbols + file_paths

Check output:
- missing_names warnings?
- budget reached warnings?

Fix warnings:
reindex missing symbols
increase budget / prune list

Verify complete:
all symbols + files present
0 warnings

ENRICH PHASE:
Append issue table +
suggestions + priority
order to output file

Final verification:
file exists, sections OK
wc -l, tail content read

Update status.md
if source was changed
bump _Last verified
